mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and ultimately positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with low unemployment, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong industrial production growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth and low unemployment indicates a growing economy with high consumer confidence, leading to increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
